notes:
Overall look:
Larger text and taller buttons and boxes.
Card titles are bigger.
In dark mode, the background is darker and text boxes are set into the cards.
Notices like “GAM 7.49.02 is available” are a soft blue-grey instead of mustard yellow.
Output panel: it starts hidden, which frees up the bottom third of the window. “Show output” in the bottom-right corner (or Ctrl+L) brings it back, and a pop-up about a failed change has a “See output” button.
Home:
Centred, so it doesn’t stretch edge to edge on a wide monitor.
One big look-up box for people and Chromebooks, with Look up, Check everything and Reset password buttons under it.
Number tiles have a coloured icon, bigger numbers and coloured status text.
Recently viewed lists people with initials and their school.
Trend lines: GAMbit now keeps one set of the Home numbers per day, so the lines will start appearing after a few days.
License tile: the license IDs now show names, such as “Education Fundamentals”. If you enter what you bought in Settings → Weekly digest, the tile shows a “% used” bar instead.
Top bar:
The domain chip shows domain name with a green dot when connected, and no longer has the “Domain:” label.
Dry run, Practice and Helper are icon-only, and show their name in colour only while switched on.
When you’re signed in to GAMbit, your account appears as your initials and first name.
Sidebar: taller rows, section headings written “PEOPLE ▾”, and your domain under the GAMbit name.
Fixes: the bar that appears when you select several table rows no longer runs off the screen (extra actions go under “More ▾”), and the bell icon now shows on its red unread badge.
